title: SugarCraft — SugarDiff
description: SugarDiff: Unified-diff engine — LCS line diff, context hunks, GNU diff -u writer and line-number scanner. Extracted from sugar-crush; first-party.
ogDescription: One faithful diff -u engine for the whole ecosystem: LCS line diffing with budgeted fallback, numbered hunks, a GNU-shaped writer, and a patch scanner that tells any gutter which line each row points at.
tagline: Unified-diff engine — hunks, writer, and patch scanner
